name: Hidden Enemies
summary: Thrall begins a covert search for the Burning Blade in Durotar. He asks a promising young adventurer to recover a Lieutenant's Insignia from Skull Rock, opening a way to uncover cultists working under the Horde's nose.

sections.title: The Rot Within Durotar
sections.body: In Durotar, the new Horde struggles to secure a home, and Warchief Thrall faces betrayal from within. The Burning Blade has taken root just outside Orgrimmar's gates. Its cultists prey on lingering demonic corruption and hunger for dark power. Thrall needs someone to watch and listen without drawing notice.

sections.title: Infiltrating Skull Rock
sections.body: Skull Rock lies east of Orgrimmar. Its rugged caverns hold warlocks, voidwalkers, and fanatical cultists. Thrall sends you to take a Lieutenant's Insignia from one of the Burning Blade leaders. The emblem is meant to open the cult's hidden ranks, so Thrall can learn who directs its movements.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Hidden Enemies?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall gives it to you in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, after you report to Orgnil Soulscar.

faq.q: What is the goal of Hidden Enemies?
aliases: what do i need for hidden enemies
faq.answer: Thrall sends you east of Orgrimmar to Skull Rock to slay Burning Blade cultists and bring him a Lieutenant's Insignia.

faq.q: Why doesn't Thrall just send his elite guards to purge Skull Rock?
faq.answer: Thrall fears an open assault would let the true conspirators slip away and hide the corruption more deeply. Someone unknown to the cult can quietly gain credentials to enter its ranks without warning the high-ranking traitors behind it.
Skull Rock is a secluded cavern system on Durotar's eastern coast, northeast of Orgrimmar. The Burning Blade uses it as a hidden stronghold and summoning den.

faq.q: What is the Lieutenant's Insignia used for?
faq.answer: The Lieutenant's Insignia proves a cultist's rank. Thrall plans to use it to disguise an operative and place them among the Burning Blade, where they can learn who directs its operations.

faq.q: What other quests can be completed alongside this one?
faq.answer: You can also collect cultist collars at Skull Rock. The cult leader Gazz'uz carries the Eye of Burning Shadow, which can begin Burning Shadows.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are entrusted by Warchief Thrall to guard the heart of the new Horde from demonic subversion.
As an orc, you know the struggle to overcome the blood-haze and shame of the demon curse. Hunting the Burning Blade is a personal fight to keep demonic blight from poisoning your people again.
As a Horde warlock, you tread carefully under Thrall's strict oversight of fel arts. He calls on you to root out cultists whose unrestrained service to demons threatens Orgrimmar's survival.
